topic: The Sticky Note That Stuck Back
background: Simple home office with a desk, chair, and blank wall
main_expression: Confident smile turning into wide-eyed confusion, then embarrassed grin
main_pose: Standing beside the desk, pointing proudly at the sticky note, then twisting around to inspect his back
prop: Bright yellow sticky note and pencil
scene_1: 0-4 seconds: K-Stick writes “DON’T FORGET THIS NOTE” on a sticky note and places it on the desk with a proud thumbs-up.
scene_2: 4-9 seconds: The note suddenly sticks to his finger. He shakes his hand, but it flies onto his face. He peels it off and puts it back on the desk, looking relieved.
scene_3: 9-12 seconds: K-Stick walks away confidently, but the sticky note is secretly stuck to the back of his shirt. He keeps pointing at the desk as if he solved the problem.
twist_ending: 12-15 seconds: He turns back and sees the note on his back. It now reads “CHECK YOUR BACK.” K-Stick slowly gives the camera an embarrassed thumbs-up.
facebook_caption: K-Stick tried to stay organized... but the sticky note had other plans! 😂
youtube_description: K-Stick writes a simple reminder, but his sticky note refuses to stay put. Watch the tiny office problem turn into a perfectly silly surprise ending.
